decision_contract: This is a local paired response audit, not calibration, confirmation or a policy scenario.
Only the two chronic MSM anal-route transmission betas may change; all contacts, diagnosis, ART, PrEP, seeding and progression controls remain fixed.
Every changed beta must remain within its existing literature bound.
The primary question is whether a beta change improves the observed 2024/2019 MSM diagnosis ratio rather than merely lifting or lowering all years.
A strict response requires improved 2024 level error, improved 2024/2019 shape error and no worsening of diagnostic primary I_max.
No profile may be promoted into the calibration or HTA baseline from this audit.
